outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental design, not a plot showing averaged data.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b mRNA expression shows individual data points (dots, n=4 per group) overlaid on the bars along with mean ± SD.
Tumor volume plot displays individual data points for each mouse overlaid with mean and 95% CI error bars.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b mRNA expression (shRNA) shows individual data points overlaid on each bar with mean ± SD.
This is a line plot of tumor volume over time with SEM error bars; line plots are exempt from the individual data point requirement since overlaying points would make it unreadable.
Quantification bar plot of CD4 intensity shows individual data points (dots) overlaid on the bars along with mean ± SD.
Quantification bar plot of pERK intensity shows individual data points (dots) overlaid on the bars along with mean ± SD.
